title: Cart matches
story: Asha asks ShopBot for biryani ingredients for 8. The cart is rice, chicken, spices and yoghurt, INR 2,800 at FreshMart, where she shops regularly. The cart check says match, and with no other warning signs the Guard allows it.

steps.item: Biryani for 8: basmati rice, chicken, biryani spices, yoghurt

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Rice, chicken, spices and yoghurt at FreshMart come to INR 2,800. Getting the cart checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Asking AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: The model's match is what lets an INR 2,800 payment through without asking Asha: the AI check adds confidence, not just friction. It can never loosen a hard limit, though; it only stands in for one warning sign.
